name: ARC Raiders
notes: UE5 title with native EAC support — Steam Deck Verified since Proton 10.0-3. Proton Wayland fixes the random 60 FPS cap and alt-tab crashes during loading cutscenes. IMPORTANT: also enable Settings → Accessibility → 'Bring game to foreground on match found' in-game — this stops the match-found freeze. NTSync improves 1% lows (kernel 6.14+). AMD: vkd3d_dxr11 is the most stable RT path on RADV. NVIDIA: use vkd3d_dxr; if DX12 stutters badly add -dx11 to Extra Flags. Audio crackle: try the PulseAudio latency fix (PipeWire users should ensure pipewire-pulse is active). The UE5 tuning flags (high priority, exclusive fullscreen, no texture streaming) are situational — test per system.
